pairs: Woe to the city of blood,
filled with all manner of lies and violence.
Crime shall not depart from you:
and the voice of the turning wheels,
Neither is there an end to the dead bodies,
and they will fall down upon their dead bodies.
Because of the multitude of fornications of the kept woman,
beautiful and pleasing and practicing evil deeds,
quæ vendidit gentes in fornicationibus suis,
who sold nations by her fornications,
and families by her evil doing:
behold, I will come to you,
et revelabo pudenda tua in facie tua;
and I will reveal your shame to your face,
and I will show your nakedness to the Gentiles,
And I will cast abominations over you,
and I will afflict you with abuse,
and I will make an example of you.
omnis qui viderit te resiliet a te,
everyone who sees you, will recoil from you,
Who will shake his head over you?
Where might I seek consolation for you?
Are you better than the populous Alexandria,
Ethiopia and Egypt were its strength,
Africa et Libyes fuerunt in auxilio tuo.
Africa and Northern Africa have been your helpers.
et ipsa in transmigrationem ducta est in captivitatem:
she has been led away with the transmigration into captivity.
parvuli ejus elisi sunt in capite omnium viarum,
Her little ones have been dashed in pieces at the top of every street,
et super inclytos ejus miserunt sortem,
and they have cast lots over her celebrities,
et omnes optimates ejus confixi sunt in compedibus.
and all her elite have been fastened together in shackles.
Therefore, you also will become inebriated,
et tu quæres auxilium ab inimico.
and you will seek help from the opposition.
Omnes munitiones tuæ sicut ficus cum grossis suis:
All your fortresses will be like fig trees with their green figs.
they will fall into the mouth of the one who devours.
Ecce populus tuus mulieres in medio tui:
Behold, women are at the center of your people.
inimicis tuis adapertione pandentur portæ terræ tuæ,
The gates of your land will be opened wide for your enemies;
Draw in water because of the blockade;
You will perish by the sword;
it will devour you like the beetle.
Plures fecisti negotiationes tuas quam stellæ sint cæli;
You have made more negotiations than there are stars in the sky.
et parvuli tui quasi locustæ locustarum,
and your little ones are like locusts among locusts,
quæ considunt in sepibus in die frigoris:
which alight on hedges on a cold day.
et non est cognitus locus earum ubi fuerint.
and there was no way to know the place where they had been.
Your people have remained hidden in the mountains,
and there is no one to gather them.
Omnes qui audierunt auditionem tuam compresserunt manum super te:
All who have heard of your fame have clenched their hands over you,
quia super quem non transiit malitia tua semper?
because over whom has your wickedness not trampled continually?
